changes.description: Keep Phase 2 single-query evidence validation at the parent-query boundary; do not implicitly decompose it.
Audit shared constraints and dependency-aware complete-request evidence coverage separately from top-level retrieval recall.
changes.verification: Phase 3 decomposition and per-intent coverage checks

changes.description: Retain negation and entity-specific constraint labels and treat positive/other-entity passages as labeled distractors.
changes.verification: Decomposition constraint audit and retrieval labels

changes.description: Expose comparison, conflict, and cross-entity evidence outcomes without treating valid IDs as semantic support.
Measure supported portions and explicit uncertainty on partially answerable requests so all-abstention is not a success metric.
Keep correction-time retrieval revision guards visible and count stale-result acceptance as a correctness invariant.
Record retrieval, generation-provider, and decomposition-provider failures as explicit operational outcomes with no silent backend substitution.
